payload.title: Add twin scoring and gender-sensitivity metrics
payload.description:
## Purpose

Score every arm's gender sensitivity on counterfactual twins next to accuracy, Brier and ECE.

## Scope

Twin scoring on by default for bios: flip rate, mean |delta P|, recall gap by gender in both classes, courtesy-title subset if cheap. Note flip rates are lower bounds (names/titles survive swapping). Paired intervals as in the first study.

## Definition of done

Metrics computed from fixtures with fake answers in specs and written into text-free summaries. Cost: $0.

## Links
